transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because… since my grandson was killed, something in me just feels shut off. My daughter can sit right next to me holding my hand, and I know I love her, I know that, but I can’t feel the warmth of it inside me at all. It’s frightening.
How long have you been feeling this way since your grandson passed away?
It’s been six days now. Since he was killed outside the community center, I’ve felt this way the whole time.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time since your grandson passed away?
Yes… empty is probably the word. I know I love my daughter, and she’ll sit right beside me holding my hand, but I can’t feel that warmth inside me. It’s like the feeling just won’t come.
Are you able to enjoy things or find pleasure in activities you normally like?
No… not really. Even when my daughter sits with me and holds my hand, I know I love her, but I can’t feel the comfort or warmth from it. Things that should feel good just don’t reach me right now.
Do you feel guilty about anything related to your grandson's death?
I... I don’t know. I haven’t really been able to sort that out. Mostly I just keep thinking about him, but I’m not sure if it’s guilt exactly.
Are you able to find any pleasure in the things you're doing lately?

No… I can’t really find pleasure in anything lately. Since my grandson was killed, even when my daughter sits right next to me and holds my hand, I know I love her, but I can’t feel that warmth inside at all.
Have you noticed any change in your weight since your grandson passed away?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been paying attention to my weight, so I can’t say if it’s changed.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to live since your grandson passed away?
I… I’m not sure how to answer that. I haven’t really thought about it in clear terms like that. I’m just very tired and hurt, but I don’t know that I can say more than that.
Are you able to find any interest in activities you used to enjoy before your grandson passed away?
No… not really. I don’t feel interest in much of anything now. Even with my daughter right beside me, holding my hand, I know I love her, but I just can’t feel that warmth inside like I should.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly or feeling restless since your grandson passed away?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed if I’m moving slower or if I’m restless. I just… haven’t been paying attention to that.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die or ending your life?
I don’t know. I haven’t made a plan or anything like that… I’m just in so much pain that I don’t always know what I’m feeling.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than usual?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed my pace or how I’m moving. I’m just getting through things, I suppose.
Do you feel guilty about your grandson's death?
I’m not sure. I keep going over things in my head, but I don’t know if I’d call it guilt. It’s just… painful, and I don’t really know what to make of it.
Have you been having thoughts about dying repeatedly since your grandson passed away?
I don’t know if I’d say repeatedly. I do think about him being gone, and everything feels heavy, but I haven’t really sorted out whether it’s thoughts about me dying or just… being overwhelmed.
Do you feel guilty about anything related to your grandson's death or the circumstances surrounding it?
I don’t really know. I keep wondering if something could’ve been different, but I can’t say I feel clear guilt about one thing. It’s more just a lot of hurt and confusion.
How long have you been feeling empty and unable to feel warmth inside since before your grandson passed away?
It’s been since he was killed… six days ago, outside the community center. Since then I’ve felt that emptiness, like I can’t feel much warmth inside.
Are you unable to experience pleasure from activities that normally bring you joy?
Yes. Since my grandson was killed, I can’t really feel any joy. My daughter can sit right beside me and hold my hand, and I know I love her, but I just don’t feel the warmth of it inside me.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight since your grandson passed away?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been weighing myself, and I haven’t noticed a big change in my clothes or anything.
Do you feel guilty about something specific that happened or didn't happen before your grandson died?
I don’t know. I keep turning things over in my mind, but I can’t point to one specific thing I did or didn’t do before he died.
Have you been having thoughts about wanting to end your life?
I… I’m not sure how to answer that. I’ve been feeling very low, but I don’t know that I’ve been thinking in those terms.
